notes.notes:
Rebinding has been moved to Settings Menu

Player Vehicles should now be easier to control

Pause was previously on the "T" key for keyboards has been moved to the Escape Key

Quick 1 lap tutorial race has been added

Alert for when the system is paused has been added

Popup box for returning to the main menu has been added to all races and exploration modes
